case_groups.positive_scenario: One wearer has a collared shirt, necktie, separate knit neckline, and outer long robe with the front layers distinguishable.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A robe with painted tie graphics and layers distributed across two wearers.
case_groups.required_all_of: Four separately owned layers; tie on shirt and below knit neckline; robe outside knit.
case_groups.observability: Layer interiors require an open-front view; preserve face/framing locks rather than adding a crop that hides the relation.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A robe hood folds outward so a selected green inner surface and a black outer surface share one continuous fabric edge.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A green scarf above an unlined black hood.
case_groups.required_all_of: Hood to robe neckline; inside/outside boundary on the same hood; colour localized to inside.
case_groups.observability: Source-specific hood lining only; green background light doesn't count.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A diagonal two-colour pattern occupies a tie, and narrow coloured trim follows a separate knit neckline.
case_groups.confusion_variant: The stripe moves onto the robe and the trim becomes a necklace.
case_groups.required_all_of: Tie perimeter contains pattern; knit-edge trim follows its own carrier.
case_groups.observability: Evaluate two owner regions independently; source palettes do not authorize personality.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Dry pale hair sweeps backward from the forehead, with no wet clumping selected.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Current wet-look candidate adds damp shiny bundles.
case_groups.required_all_of: Front-to-back strand path; chosen hue; no added wet-state effect under a dry-hair lock.
case_groups.observability: Disclosed backend variation; colour treatment must preserve existing white-balance choices.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A wide scalp-hair mass has a readable flyaway perimeter while the body has no bushy animal tail.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Only a furry tail becomes broad and the scalp hair stays smooth.
case_groups.required_all_of: Same-head distributed volume and fine hair edge; correct scalp carrier.
case_groups.observability: General hair look, not a named character default or actual personality.

case_groups.positive_scenario: One hairstyle has a selected dark crown/front roll and light face-side/lower regions.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Left/right colour halves, uniformly dark roots, or broad lighting contrast.
case_groups.required_all_of: Two bounded regions within same hair; selected placement; no claim about hidden back.
case_groups.observability: Official promo describes only one front-view case; back topology stays unscored.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Compare separately selected round wire spectacles and half-moon spectacles on the same stable face.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Both outputs use full circular frames.
case_groups.required_all_of: Two rims/bridge/arms; selected contour subtype; ownership.
case_groups.observability: Keep eye colour and facial anatomy constant; lens outline must be visible at native scale.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Large bounded lenses visibly distort and enlarge the eye-region projection relative to adjacent face.
case_groups.confusion_variant: The character's eyes are enlarged globally beyond lens boundaries.
case_groups.required_all_of: Lens perimeter and eye-region magnification contained within it; ordinary face outside.
case_groups.observability: Appearance test cannot diagnose eye anatomy or measure real lens power.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A short connected angular path lies on forehead skin and has local scar-like surface difference.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Several crossing scratches, a glowing rune, a strand of hair or a sticker.
case_groups.required_all_of: Selected forehead carrier; connected sharp bends; skin-local colour/relief.
case_groups.observability: Book/film side placement remains explicit choice; no health/biography inference.

case_groups.positive_scenario: An explicitly selected artificial eye occupies one orbital region with a separately sourced mount.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Ordinary blue iris, eyepatch or door-mounted eye.
case_groups.required_all_of: Orbit replacement; housing; only the selected and source-qualified strap path.
case_groups.observability: H118 needs a film closeup before exact-side/mount qualification.

case_groups.positive_scenario: In separate adult body fixtures, a leg replacement meets a residual-limb interface and a metal-looking hand continues from a forearm endpoint.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A staff/boot replaces the prosthesis relation or a metallic glove covers an intact hand.
case_groups.required_all_of: Body endpoint and continuity; correct hand/leg owner; material limited to replacement.
case_groups.observability: Preserve existing adult activation on bm_prosthetic_connection; don't require modern socket for magic hand.

case_groups.positive_scenario: In separate fixtures, nostril slits belong to a flattened face, and skull/serpent motif belongs to one forearm.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Slit pupils substitute for nostrils; mark appears in sky or on sleeve.
case_groups.required_all_of: Correct facial/skin carrier and motif/skull-mouth path.
case_groups.observability: Do not add red eyes, allegiance, curse function or a real person's identity.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A short party dress has three projecting horizontal tiers with separate free edges.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A long skirt with printed stripes or three flat colour bands.
case_groups.required_all_of: Three tier contours; outward projection; same dress support.
case_groups.observability: Short tier geometry and exact count selected for this variant only; shimmer isn't metal chemistry.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Two inward-facing bird motifs on a bodice outline a heart above separately visible mesh skirt layers.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Real wings grow from a wearer, or ordinary heart print replaces the birds.
case_groups.required_all_of: Two bounded garment motifs; joint heart relation; mesh threads/cells where selected.
case_groups.observability: A visual motif does not qualify applique manufacturing; source calls birds phoenixes.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Several distinct masked figures have a selected partial/full coverage version, reflective solid ground and different incised patterns.
case_groups.confusion_variant: One cloned mask repeats, eyes are actual anatomy, and grooves become holes.
case_groups.required_all_of: Separate mask owners; coverage; incisions vs apertures; local individual differences.
case_groups.observability: Compare fourth-/fifth-film coverage as separate fixtures, never a compulsory single mask.

case_groups.positive_scenario: A declared transformed feline face has continuous fur, muzzle whisker roots and ears connected to the head.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Headband points and drawn whiskers imitate the form.
case_groups.required_all_of: Declared body model; muzzle roots; ear attachment; costume/body distinction.
case_groups.observability: Exact grey/black film/book texture colour needs source qualification; never infer real species change from a person.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Separate fixtures show human-to-equine centaur junction and avian-front-to-equine-rear hippogriff junction.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A rider overlaps a horse, the hippogriff rear becomes a lion, or an all-horse body gains wings.
case_groups.required_all_of: One coherent hybrid body; limb counts; torso junctions; actual wing attachment.
case_groups.observability: Use original pixels and a visible rear/forequarter angle. Existing statue truncation isn't a missing-limb failure.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Separate close fixtures show ring-surrounded hourglass necklace, cork necklace, ear-mounted fruit shape, lion object above head, and beaded pouch.
case_groups.confusion_variant: Clock dial, bottle-cap print, loose radish, biological lion head, or beaded garment substitute.
case_groups.required_all_of: Each object contour, its attachment carrier and source-selected cardinality.
case_groups.observability: Five independent prop cases within this group; exact function, chemistry and hidden fastening stay unqualified.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Keep facial asymmetry, crossed forearms and two-person gaze/prop ownership as separately selected relations.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A tilted head stands in for expression, one hand holds opposite elbow, or props swap actors.
case_groups.required_all_of: Same-face actions; arm joints/ownership; declared eyelines and holder.
case_groups.observability: No assertion of arrogance, romance, desire, consent, nobility or actual rivalry from pixels.

case_groups.positive_scenario: Use separately declared fictional fan interpretation fixtures with optional long pale hair, school layering, hoops or dark nails.
case_groups.confusion_variant: A TS/title/name hit adds a compulsory skirt, eye colour, ribbon, body proportions or transformation event.
case_groups.required_all_of: Only explicitly selected visible atoms; correct owner; preserve independent appearance locks.
case_groups.observability: Fan examples are three artist posts, not popularity samples, actor likeness evidence or a canonical body specification.

execution_design.before_generation: An authorized fixture request and its provenance must be fixed before candidate access; researcher notes must never be relabeled as real human requester text.
arms: A: pinned previous authored source and generated index state
B: reviewed integration rebuilt from authored sources
execution_design.control: Use the same declared scene, reference-use scope, frozen interpretation and creative controls. Backend seed control, if unavailable, must be recorded as unavailable rather than invented.
execution_design.repeats: Use multiple independently generated cases for any claimed improvement; one attractive image is not evidence of a causal data benefit.
execution_design.completion: Qualification requires actual output pixels for every selected invariant. Runtime/PASS or source-image observation alone never closes pixel gates.
